label: Come out of the Scottish court with something to show
description: A burgh customs contract is the prize; the family currently holding the king is the hazard.

label: Find the child
description: The trail can be followed further or less far. It cannot be followed to the end — not this chapter.

label: Settle terms with the sultan's customs
description: Alexandria for the warehouse, Cairo for the prices. Licensed or unlicensed is the whole question.

label: See the St Catherine's consignment through
description: Buy Venetian glass at Venice, and have the ship at St Catherine's still carrying at least 3 crates of it — Alexandria, then Cairo, then three weeks inland. Then bring the ship back down to Cairo to close the account. The safe-conduct lasts 30 weeks from the day the commission is taken.

label: Learn who the Vatachino are
description: Three pieces of the file name them. Two come to the house on their own; the third is bought from a Genoese notary, or lifted by an agent placed inside the company itself.

label: Put the gift to deliberate use
description: Water at St Catherine's, ore at Edinburgh, a direction at Cairo — three uses, four weeks' recovery apiece, and Conscience each time. None of it is required; all of it opens something.
